authoritative_data: FixtureResultService stores explicit fixture provenance in auxiliary owned rows; it does not own a real solver or a general postprocessing model.

input_output: StoredFixtureResult: id/principal/signature/artifact_id and ResultBundle. Bundle retains quantity/unit/components/location/coordinate_basis/case/frame/source_kind/input signature and numbering map.
FrozenInputResolver obtains matching verified artifact input. read admits Caller/WriteContext/key and stores the result; get reads by Caller/DocumentRef/result_id.
implemented_subset.errors_and_effects: Provenance/location/unit/fingerprint/number-map mismatch rejects fixture admission. get is read-only; current/stale is derived from the frozen input and current model. A persisted fixture or successful process exit is not engineering solver validation.

implemented_subset.implemented_boundary: Read is not side-effect-free postprocessing: it persists a CAS/idempotent owned-row result. ResultProjection charts, derived fields and real solver output are outside this explicit fixture public subset.
